Also in today's newsletter, *New York* moves to block *Polymarket* , a Brooklyn man gets up to 12 years over a $16 million *Coinbase* social engineering scheme, *IBM* connects Digital Asset Haven to *SWIFT* for tokenized deposit transactions, and more.

Meanwhile, *Solana Foundation* tapped ( https://www.theblock.co/news/ecosystems/2026-09-24-solana-foundation-taps-binance-polygon-vets-to-drive-institutional-adoption-and-payments-416254?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) former *Binance and Polygon* executives to drive institutional adoption and payments, and *Ondo* launched ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-09-24-ondo-launches-onchain-portfolio-tokens-based-blackrock-developed-strategies-416260?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) onchain portfolio tokens based on *BlackRock* -developed strategies.

Bush had toppled tyrannies in Afghanistan and Iraq with televised ease. Saddam Hussein had been captured skulking in a spider hole. Fearing the same fate, Libya’s dictator, Muammar Qaddafi, had given up his nuclear-weapons programme.

Over the past several months, new technologies and innovative market models have emerged, creating new opportunities for investors, issuers, and market participants.   As this evolution is rapidly moving to an operating reality with live transactions and institutional adoption, Nasdaq is leading the charge in reducing friction, expanding access and making markets more efficient.   Advancing Tokenized Equities: Nasdaq Deepens Relationship with Payward  Nasdaq is advancing its tokenized equities strategy through an agreement to invest $100 million in Payward, the parent company of Kraken. The investment builds on the collaboration announced in March and supports Nasdaq's vision for an equity token framework that places public companies at the center of ownership rights, transparency, and governance.  As part of the expanded relationship, Payward will also adopt Nasdaq's market surveillance technology across its trading venues, helping align market innovation with institutional-grade oversight.  Read more.  Building the Market Infrastructure: DLN Launch and LeveL Markets Acquisition  Nasdaq announced a definitive agreement to acquire LeveL Markets, a leading off-exchange equity execution venue in the United States. The acquisition supports Nasdaq's broader vision for always-on markets by strengthening the way liquidity is connected and accessed across an increasingly continuous global economy.  Nasdaq also launched Digital Liquidity Networks (DLN), bringing together capabilities across digital assets and tokenized securities to help architect the next era of capital markets. Together, these moves represent a significant step toward building the infrastructure required for an always-on market environment.  Learn more.   Tokenized Collateral Goes Live: Vanguard and Wellington Complete First Trades  Roland Chai, President of DLN, announced that Vanguard and Wellington Management completed their first tokenized collateral transactions on the Canton Network.
